description: Use this when asked whether something delivered what was promised, whether claims are true, or whether citations are accurate. Pass `citations`, or `claims` (+ `url`), or a service `url` plus the `result` you got. Returns which check ran and each result. Free, no account; records a GAIP receipt only. Inputs must be public and non-personal.

checks.description: Optional (delivery): what a good response is: http_status_in {allowed}, content_type_is {value}, non_empty, json_parses. Default: HTTP 200, non-empty.

citations.description: Citations to check: each {url, quote?} or just a URL. GAIP fetches each page once (robots.txt respected) and looks for the quote.

claims.description: Claims to compare with observations: each a sentence or {id, text}.

continuity_handle.description: Optional: the continuity_handle from an earlier GAIP result; links this call to your earlier ones (needed to see or remove your watches later).

metadata.description: Optional (claims): the published agent card, MCP or OpenAPI document.

observations.description: Optional (claims): what you saw, each {claim_id, result: PASS|FAIL, detail}.

result.description: Optional (delivery): the response you received. Omitted: GAIP fetches the service URL now (public replay).

terms_id.description: Optional (delivery): terms_id from an earlier registration, instead of url.

url.description: Claims: the agent or supplier they are about. Delivery: the public https service URL that should deliver.

name: gaip_verify
title: Verify claims, citations or a delivery
